product_wide_rationale: Failed worker attempts remain terminal evidence, so retries require exact operator approval and fresh execution fencing without becoming typed restart.
summary: Failed retries below the three-attempt wall require exact approval and fresh fencing; escalated retries require one single-use store-derived findings_shrinking or approach_changed basis. Oracle histories compare exact canonical ranked-finding sets with retained contract, job, owner, and byte-identical old control obligations plus supported closure evidence. Predicate IDs are not finding IDs. Oracle-defect closures, replacement findings, and recipe re-pins cannot mint shrink credit; accepted no_ship remains nonproductive. Historical comparison and operator authority remain unchanged.
title: Failed worker retries require exact approval and fresh fencing
